metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:embedding_collapse_score: Mean off-diagonal cosine similarity of up to 2048 real item embeddings, mapped from [-1,1] to [0,1]. About 0.5 corresponds to zero mean cosine; values approaching 1 indicate directional alignment. This does not measure recommendation diversity or unobserved simulator traits. Null means insufficient pairs.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean of (pos_logit - neg_logit) over valid positions; higher means clearer separation.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_margin_p10: 10th percentile of (pos_logit - neg_logit); lower suggests many hard/confusing cases.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction where neg_logit > pos_logit (margin < 0); lower is better.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction where (pos_logit - neg_logit) < eps; higher means weak separation.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_margin_category_br: Contains measured valid-position, low-margin and wrong-rank counts with eps=0.5. Valid positions require nonzero input, positive and negative IDs. Category breakdowns are null because item categories are unavailable. All margin metrics are null when no valid samples exist. These are sampled training margins, not validation HR@10 or a full-catalog ranking measurement.
